I’m checking the existing edit pattern and tests next.

The rename feature is not implemented. [DeviceDetails.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx:64) renders a static name, while [useOwnDevices.ts](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/useOwnDevices.ts:133) exposes no `saveDeviceName`. Both current and other sessions reach `DeviceDetails` through [CurrentDeviceSection.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx:61) and [FilteredDeviceList.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/FilteredDeviceList.tsx:159), with props originating in [SessionManagerTab.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/tabs/user/SessionManagerTab.tsx:168).

The fix should add `DeviceDetailHeading`, pass `(deviceId, deviceName)` through that chain, call the SDK’s `setDeviceDetails`, and update hook state after success so the name changes immediately. The heading needs the 100-character edit form, save progress, cancel behavior, stable test hooks, and the exact failure text “Failed to set display name.” [CurrentDeviceSection.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx:49) also needs to limit its spinner to loading without a device. Existing tests cover rendering and expansion, but not renaming; the save behavior remains unverified.

The required diagnosis-only role restriction prevented source and test edits. I recorded the findings in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
